subject: Pilot window hold request: PO routing delay at Greenfield Health
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@greenfieldhealth.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Pilot access hold — PO routing delay

Hi Markus,

We've hit a snag on our side: the purchase order for the Redwood pilot is still being validated by our vendor onboarding team and procurement put the PO into a short review. That means our sandbox is going to time out on Friday and the engineering team won't be able to finish the integration work we promised for next week.

Is there any way Redwood can hold the pilot open or grant a very short-term token top-up while we route the PO? We can share the PO draft and a procurement contact to accelerate. This is a high-priority internal project for us so we want to avoid losing momentum.

Thanks,
Sophie Turner
Director, Product Integrations
Greenfield Health

Attachment: Greenfield_PO_draft_1234.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Pilot access hold — PO routing delay

Hi Sophie — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO draft. I understand the need to keep the integration on track.

Quick proposal: we can provision a 7-day sandbox credit top-up to keep your team running while procurement finishes the PO routing. To do this I need internal approval from Finance and confirmation from our CS team that the account and usage profile are as expected. Grace, Laura — can you weigh in? If you approve, I'll provision the top-up today and add a note to the deal in HubSpot (GD-4839).

Sophie — can you confirm the expected PO total and whether the procurement contact wants a formal invoice or will accept a pro forma note while the PO clears? Also confirmed receipt of Greenfield_PO_draft_1234.pdf.

Best,
Markus Klein
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4839

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:27:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Pilot access hold — PO routing delay

Markus — fine by me to approve a short 7-day top-up to preserve momentum. Based on the usage CSV you attached, the required buffer looks small. Laura — can Finance flag the account and note the temporary credit so we can reconcile against the incoming PO?

If procurement at Greenfield needs a billing contact or an invoice in the meantime let me know and I can provide the minimal details.

-grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Pilot access hold — PO routing delay

Thanks Grace — Finance will approve a one-time 7-day credit as a conditional allowance against PO GD-4839. Please ensure the PO draft is attached to the HubSpot deal and procurement email address is added as the billing contact. We'll treat this as 'credit pending PO' and will automatically reconcile once the PO or payment is received.

Markus — I'll need the PO number or DocuSign link once it is available so we can clear the exception in our system.

Laura Bennett
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@greenfieldhealth.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:07:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Pilot access hold — PO routing delay

Markus / Grace / Laura — thank you all for the quick responses and for approving the top-up. We've attached the PO draft and procurement contact information to the HubSpot deal as requested. Procurement has also shared the expected PO number once final (will follow up with DocuSign).

We appreciate the runway — I'll confirm as soon as DocuSign is sent.

Best,
Sophie

Attachment: Greenfield_PO_draft_1234.pdf (pdf stub)
Related: DocuSign to follow — https://www.docusign.com/party/8a7f2d-link
